name: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc
summary: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc is a holding company, which engages in the exploration and development of natural resources. It operates through the following geographical segments: Republic of Ireland, Greenland, and England and Wales. It focuses on gold, graphite, ilmenite, base metals, and iron ore projects. The company was founded on November 12, 2004 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
